description: Canonical coverage matrix for MPL ID S18. Joins the database snapshot, transcript plan and ledgers, visual status, and page inventory.

definitions.match_evidence_pass: The match report exists and contains the deterministic database evidence block; transcript coverage is recorded separately and must not be implied when absent.

definitions.transcript: A source ledger exists and the report carries validated transcript observations; partial sources are labeled.
